NewslettersHe pānui

Stay in the loop with the wide range of happenings at Te Papa. There’s something for everyone – from active Wellingtonians and museum lovers, to art fans, teachers, museum professionals, iwi, and more.

Note: All newsletters are managed through MailChimp.

What’s On at Te Papa

Frequency: Monthly, plus occasional announcements

Be the first to know about upcoming events, exciting new exhibitions, and special offers at Te Papa.

Subscribe to What’s On at Te Papa

Blog

Frequency: As posts are published

Discover behind-the-scenes stories from Te Papa’s experts, including curators, scientists, historians, collection managers, and educators.

Subscribe to Te Papa’s blog

School holidays at Te Papa

Frequency: Once a term

We run a jam-packed school holiday programme every term – from free performances and activities to paid educator-led learning programmes. By signing up to our school holidays mailing list you'll be the first to know about what we've got on, and get your kids booked on to our fast-selling sessions.

Subscribe to the school holidays mailing list

Te Papa Learning

Frequency: 2–3 per term

Hear about our new education programmes, resources, and exhibitions, plus opportunities for teacher previews and professional development.

Subscribe to Te Papa Learning

Te Papa Press

Frequency: Quarterly

Find out the latest about books published by Te Papa Press.

Subscribe to the Te Papa Press newsletter

National Services Te Paerangi

Frequency: Quarterly, with monthly updates

Keep up with the latest news and opportunities from National Services Te Paerangi (NSTP), and across the museum sector – including professional development opportunities, events, and workshops.

Subscribe to the National Services Te Paerangi newsletter

Te Papa Venues

Frequency: Quarterly, plus occasional announcements

From waterfront conferences to gala events, and celebrations, Te Papa and Tākina Wellington Convention and Exhibition Centre are two of Wellington’s most iconic event destinations. Be the first to hear about new event packages, seasonal menus, and exclusive offers.

Subscribe to the Te Papa Venues newsletter

Friends of Te Papa

Frequency: Regular

For the vibrant Friends of Te Papa community. Hear about the latest news and events, discounts, exhibition previews, and more.

Subscribe to the Friends of Te Papa newsletter

Sending frequencies are indicative only and may vary.

Te Papa Foundation

Frequency: Quarterly, plus occasional announcements

The Te Papa Foundation is the philanthropic arm of Te Papa, raising funds that extend the museum’s capacity to preserve, enrich and share the national collection. Stay up-to-date with our campaigns and events, and learn more about giving through the Te Papa Foundation.

Subscribe to the Te Papa Foundation newsletter

Kōtuia

Frequency: Quarterly

Keep up with news about the online collections portal Kōtuia ngā Kete (formally NZ Museums) which contains the collection items of over 70 museums, galleries and whare taonga throughout Aotearoa New Zealand.

Subscribe to Kōtuia ngā Kete newsletter
